name: Acceptance suite-3 test 58 - duplicate nested Condition key -> BLOCKED at exact path
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign A. Duplicate detection must cover EVERY object depth, not just top-level statement members. aws:PrincipalOrgID is repeated inside Condition.StringEquals; the engine must fail closed with DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY and locate it at Statement[0].Condition.StringEquals.aws:PrincipalOrgID. No org-constrained finding may be emitted.
rationale: A duplicate condition key is as dangerous as a duplicate Action: last-key-wins would let an attacker override an org restriction (o-approved) with a permissive value (o-attacker) that survives the parse. Recursive duplicate detection at the exact JSON path is required so the guard cannot be bypassed by nesting. Ref: RFC 8259 section 4 + IAM condition block grammar.
